notes.title: Version 1.005 Released - Bug Fixes and more hotkeys
notes.content:
A new version of Battle Group 2 will be up on Steam shortly. This version includes the following:
[list]
[*]Added new hot keys for abilities. The defaults are A and 1 for Reload, B and 2 for EMP and D and 3 for Hypertime. These can be customized in the config screen when the game first loads
[*]Fix Iowa firing when it should not on hotkey
[*]Don't reload secondaries on Hypertime
[/list]
Thanks for everyone who has reported bugs. We will aim to fix any issues found as soon as we can.

notes.title: Version 1.004 Released - Bug Fixes
notes.content:
We've just released version 1.004 to Steam. This build includes bug fixes for the following:
[list]
[*]Fix Frogfoot, Flanker and Hind kills not being registered
[*]Fix stats not saving correctly when closing the game
[*]Check for missed achievements on startup
[/list]
My apologies that these bugs made their way into the final build.
